## Documentation location convention

- **English docs**: Root of the repository (no prefix), e.g. `aphanite/troubleshooting.md`.
- **Chinese docs**: Under the `zh/` prefix, e.g. `zh/aphanite/troubleshooting.md`.

When syncing a Chinese doc to English, create the English version at the corresponding path without the `zh/` prefix. Update all internal links accordingly (e.g. `/zh/aphanite/...` → `/aphanite/...`)`.
